title: BAW cluster node throwing OutOfMemoryError under morning peak load
description: Every morning between 08:30 and 09:30 when all users log in simultaneously, one of the BAW cluster nodes throws OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space and becomes unresponsive. The load balancer eventually routes traffic to the second node but it takes 2-3 minutes. This started after we onboarded 40 new users last week.
